statement: The following are the Local Transference Theorem, its Endpoint Pairing Corollary, and the Absolute Physical Bounds Lemma of [4, Section 3, Theorem 3.5, 13 Corollary 3.11, and Lemma 3.4]. Assume P ν sup |Kν| ≤ LC1 , where m0, C1 are fixed independently of J. For every fixed E > 0 there is an Eid > 0, depending only on E and the group data, such that sup Θ∈R ∥Tζ(Θ)∥2→2 ≤ L−Eid implies the following conclusion for all sufficiently large fixed J. Let I = [X, 2X) with xγ ≤ X ≤ x1/γ for some fixed γ > 0. If f is supported on positions in I, is independent of the chosen marks, and sup |f| ≤ exp(O( √ L)), ∥f∥, ∥g∥ ≤ X1/2 LC3 , then |⟨f, Aζg⟩| ≪ XL−E+2C3 . (4.9) The lower bound for J may depend on m0, C1; the threshold for x may also depend on J, the fixed exponent bounding |k|, and γ. There is no additional restriction on ζ beyond the ideal norm hypothesis. The operator obtained by taking absolute values of all transition coefficients has row and column sums at most LCabs , with Cabs independent of J.
